translations.web: He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish? He who teaches man knows.
translations.bsb: He who admonishes the nations, does He not discipline? He who teaches man, does He lack knowledge?
translations.kjv: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge,
translations.asv: He that chastiseth the nations, shall not he correct, Even he that teacheth man knowledge?
